profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Intuit
profile.summary:
I am currently a Full Stack Software Engineer, who likes to use his creative ability to build
meaningful and aesthetically pleasing applications. I love a challenge and solving difficult
programming tasks. My background in Human Computer Interaction and Computer
Science helps me be a well-rounded individual in front-end and back-end technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Main focus was creating complex React components and it’s integration with our backend services written in Go
• Micoservice architecture with Docker Containers and leveraging Kubernetes orchestration  
• Used React and Javascript to create a user interactive graph library
• Created client-side form validation with React, Redux, and yup
• The UI leveraged Redux to manage the data we received from our back end services by using gRPC-Web
• Responsible of maintaining, troubleshooting, and creating back end services, which were all written in Go
• Setup and maintaining Azure CI/CD Pipelines using the Github/flow branching strategies and integration with Docker, Helm, Kubernetes
• Working with Kubernetes and leveraging it’s different utilities, such as Argo and Cronjobs
• FrontEnd: React, Redux, and Material-UI
• BackEnd: gRPC, Protocol Buffers, Golang and MongoDB

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
• Transition to a team lead and fulfilling the past Sr. Web Developer role and responsibilities on the team
• Built AxosBank.com coming soon page in React and CSS Grids 
• Assisted the build of our UI Kit in Angular 5
• Assisted in the CMS transition from DotNetNuke to Sitecore
• Formerly known as BofI Federal Bank

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Focused on Web Accessibility, integrating Marketo/Action forms, Salesforce lead integration, and Salesforce live chat
• Created custom scripts for Action Form and Marketo to improve our lead conversion event tracking in Google Analytics and Velocify
• Worked mostly in Javascript

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
• Responsible for maintaining 9 dierent marketing websites and producing new landing pages for marketing campaigns
• Completed 5 different website redesigns, which included: NetBank, Bank of Internet, BofI Advisor, Apartment Bank, and UFB Direct
• Responsible for managing our websites Optimization eorts, such as A/B Testing using tools such as Google Suite (Analytics, Optimize Tag Manager) and Optimizely
• Built and manage Forms, Calculators, and custom web functionality
• Work mostly with HTML, CSS, Javascript/JQuery, sometimes SQL, and third party APIs

positions.title: Residential Computing Consultant
positions.description: Computer and network troubleshooting and configuration. Malware/virus removal, data transfer, file recover, Operating System installs. Provided basic Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support and cater to customer service and build teamwork skills in a work environment.

company.name: UCSD Academic Computing and Media Services

positions.title: Social Chair (Executive Board)
positions.description:
• Formerly known as UXSD, Design.UCSD
• Responsible for setting up Design Challenges and Portfolio/Resume Reviews.
• Hosted events to help UCSD UX community engage with real world mentors in the community, such as Digital Telepathy and Don Norman. 
• ￼￼Design.UCSD is a pre-professional organization that aims to be the center of design thinking here at UCSD. We assist students in bridging the gap between the Human Computer Interaction program and the industry by providing students the ability to refine their skills and prepare them for the real world.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description: Continued designing a mobile application concept to assist families that are below the poverty level in San Diego

positions.title: User Experience Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: User Interface and User experience development. Assisted in developing Hush Technology’s iOS application. Assisted in many graphic design projects for the Kickstarter and Advertisements.

courses.name: Basic Data Structures and Object-Oriented Design

projects.title: CROWN
projects.description:
CROWN  is an interactive goal-based web calendar where users can set their long-term and short-term goals that they are passionate about, and visualize their calendar and personal events in a new way through a vertical timeline view.  CROWN is for students to effectively manage and maximize their time to fulfill their goals and to make the important, urgent.  I also created the website with HTML, CSS, JS, and jQuery with my team.  
Top design chosen by instructors in HCI course

Role: UX Designer & Front-End Developer

projects.title: Timeline
projects.description:
Timeline is a working mobile application that visualizes people's personal events based on priority in a vertical timeline view.  This was a deeper study into time and information visualization in the Cognitive Science field, and we created prototypes and conducted user testing on the mobile application.  

Role: UX Researcher
